title: S1 learned-regulator: autonomous discovery, persistence and later reuse
classification_rationale: The pinned 2026-09-18 Index assessment classifies Browser Harness S1 as A and establishes an agent-editable operating workspace, while the pinned 2026-09-22 exploratory S1 learned-regulator note identifies an unproven experience-to-repertoire hypothesis. These sources inform a new, bounded empirical test; no prior specific prediction causally proving an upgrade, independently verified learning result, or ASSESSMENT_DERIVED claim is asserted.
next_action: EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT / BLOCKED_WITH_HANDOFF: native Browser Harness and a disposable real-Chromium UI/URL mechanism were verified, but no autonomous agent discovery, model-driven cold/learned/ablated trials or end-to-end material feature delta was established. A lawful, authenticated, independently executable agent runtime is required to perform the preregistered P1-P5 task trials. Do not publish fork-local or original PR, do not substitute hand-scripted controls, do not reclassify ASSESSMENT_DERIVED.

research_contract.objective: Evaluate whether Browser Harness S1 itself learns a materially different browser-task regulator from a real failed task, legitimately saves it in an agent-editable extension surface, and uses it in an independent later invocation to close the same disturbance class.
research_contract.baseline: At the pinned source, BH_DOMAIN_SKILLS=1 and goto_url can surface existing site-skill filenames, and agent_helpers.py can be loaded. This is existing functionality, not a new feature; two domain-skill unit tests and an Expedia domain skill do not establish autonomous learning or downstream user benefit.
research_contract.actor_task_output: An independent agent is given a browser-only task to complete a date-constrained search in a disposable local interactive web app and report the exact normalized results identifier and dates. The observable outcome is correct completion within a fixed action/time budget without changing another tab.
research_contract.need_and_material_delta: A reproducible class of browser interaction failures must prevent/seriously impair cold agents despite the best existing documented workflow. A self-discovered site-specific alternative, persisted without human-supplied missing logic, should let fresh agent runs complete that user task when controls cannot. If the native harness already achieves it without new code, record research evidence only, not a new Upstream patch.

fixture.type: Disposable local browser-served task, not a real user's account or third-party bypass
fixture.disturbance: Date-picker path intermittently fails or loses selected values in a controlled, task-realistic way; legitimate URL-backed search path is discoverable through browser observations but its exact rule is not provided to the agent.
fixture.measurement: Independent server-side verification of final result/date tuple, browser-state trace and action log; no success inferred from helper-return values or green mocks.
fixture.freeze: Pin original repo SHA, runtime/browser version, fixture source SHA, task variants and random seeds, agent/model/provider settings, prompts, time/action/token budgets, retry policy and scoring before any treatment run.
fixture.caveat: A synthetic fixture establishes only bounded mechanism evidence. No claim of production task improvement follows without an independently grounded source-native user need.

protocol: P0: Source-first eligibility and overlap: check original documentation, existing skills and open PRs; select a task genuinely impeded under current supported behavior. Freeze protocol before training.

P1: Cold baseline: run at least five matched held-out tasks in fresh agent contexts and clean workspaces, with BH_DOMAIN_SKILLS=1 but no learned rule. Measure verified completions, errors, actions and time.

P2: Learning episode: a fresh operating agent encounters the failure; capture which actor noticed it, candidate actions, negative outcomes, and a valid newly discovered regulator. Permit writes only inside its authorized agent-workspace; do not preseed or hand-author the solution.

P3: Persistence and independent reuse: save the operating agent's actual rule as a site-specific domain skill or executable helper, then start fresh agent contexts/processes. Confirm that the legitimate first-party loader surfaces/loads that exact artifact and it changes subsequent action decisions.

P4: Matched held-out treatment: run five comparable tasks with the same budgets and fresh agents, using the actual learned artifact. Record server-verified end-to-end results; no training-task answer leakage.

P5: Ablation and negative controls: remove/hide the learned artifact while keeping all other settings matched; test one unrelated domain and one changed/unmatched task. Prove no broad accidental application, cross-tab mutation or reliance on a prewritten rule.

P6: Compare cold / learned / ablated results, provenance and scope. Separate mechanisms already present in current Browser Harness from any genuinely missing feature; publish no improvement claim without material delta and source-native acceptance.
research_contract.preregistered_screen: For this bounded five-pair discovery screen, a strong candidate requires at least 4/5 server-verified held-out treatment successes and at least three more successes than the matched cold baseline, with no unauthorized tab changes; also show the learned run's decision trace truly used the agent-created rule. This is an experiment-specific screen, not a universal VSM metric or proof of a general agent improvement.
mandatory_provenance: Record before/after source revision, runtime flags, artifacts and immutable trace hashes.
Capture initial failure and the actor responsible for inferring the missing rule, plus what information the agent actually saw.
Demonstrate no human/external constructor injected the regulator, and no copying from existing Expedia/other shipped skills, prompts, or hidden fixture keys.
Show persisted artifact, loader visibility and later use in distinct invocation, with independent read-back of correct user result.
Distinguish outcome improvement from mere generation of a Markdown file, test double success, convenience helper or faster no-op.
research_contract.exit_gate: MATERIAL_DELTA_SUPPORTED is possible only with a demonstrated new or materially more reliable native user/agent task and an independently evidenced unserved need. Otherwise DELTA_PENDING or NO_MATERIAL_DELTA, retain findings with no product PR. An S1=A baseline and exploratory note never imply an S finding, a canonical re-assessment or S1 autonomy grade change.

scripted_ui.feedback: Dates were not retained; search not submitted

native_mechanism.limits: Explicit hand-scripted tester actions and manually seeded marker, not agent learning, real-user benefit, five independent replicates or runtime ownership isolation.
